{"metadata":{"description":"DSH web plugin: per-day token usage statistics with a GitHub-style activity heatmap, cache hit-rate curve and per-model breakdown","id":"gh:1339889691","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-usage-statistics-panel","slug":"HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel","topics":["cordis","data-visualization","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","llm","plugin","react","settings-panel","svg-charts","token-meter","token-usage","typescript","usage-statistics"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH web plugin: per-day token usage statistics with a GitHub-style activity heatmap, cache hit-rate "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"curve and per-model breakdown"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Usage Statistics Panel"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DSH web 插件的用量统计面板：按天 / 按小时的 Token 趋势、GitHub 风格活跃热力图、缓存命中率曲线、按模型与按供应商两种用量拆分（环形占比图 + 明细列表），作为**插件**页中本"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"插件的独立页面，并在左侧栏提供独立入口。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"所有图表均为手绘 SVG，不依赖图表库；配色是固定的 rank 色板（`--dsw-chart-1..10` 给模型前 10 名、`--dsw-provider-1..5` 给供应商前 5 名，其余归"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"入灰色 "Other" 桶），暗色主题下整体提亮，随 DSH 主题自适应。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 预览"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 功能"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **时间范围**：今日、最近 3 / 7 / 14 / 30 / 90 天，或自定义起止日期；今日与最近 3 天按小时汇总，其余按天
